task.description:
Step 0.5 — Registry lookup + ISS file creation + GitHub issue update for GH-759.

GitHub issue: https://github.com/tvolodi/R-Co/issues/759
Title: 'TC-RG-01/TC-RG-02 fail on main: T010 baseline has 117 BLOCKERs but GH-512 snapshot expects 116 — snapshot stale after WF02-batch-0 commit 0d9041b5'
Labels: bug, good first issue, claimed-by-r-co-1-loop

Tasks:
1. Search docs/issues/ for any existing ISS-NNNN.json that references GitHub issue #759. Use scratch/find_iss_for_gh.py if it exists, or grep docs/issues/issue_index.json for 759.
2. If no ISS file exists, create docs/issues/ISS-NNNN.json with the next free number. Cross-check with docs/issues/issue_index.json (the index should have the same id).
3. Update docs/issues/issue_index.json to add the new ISS entry (if it wasn't already there).
4. Set severity = MINOR (per the existing fix commit 0fff689f's analysis: 'Third recurrence of a known drift class').
5. Status = REGISTERED.
6. Note the related_to: ISS-0648 (GH-653), ISS-0664 (GH-701) — the previous recurrences of this drift class.
7. Write a brief symptom + scope + acceptance criteria (mirror the existing fix's ISS-0692.json as a template since this is the same class of fix applied in a fresh WF03 run).
8. Return the new ISS-NNNN id in your result. Do not modify source code or test files — that is Step 3 work.

Critical reminders:
- Per core-directives.md: never invent timestamps. Run `python tools/utcnow.py` for `registered_at`.
- Write files with encoding='utf-8' (no BOM).
- Read with encoding='utf-8-sig'.
- Append `ISS-NNNN` to docs/issues/issue_index.json in the correct spot. Do not regenerate the file.
- Do NOT push to remote or create a GitHub issue (GH-759 already exists; if you want to comment, use gh issue comment, but the issue is already filed).
